info.name: Tiger SMS Public API
info.description: Generated from config/api_methods.php + App\Features\Api\Support\ApiMethodSchemas. Set the `baseUrl` and `api_key` collection variables before sending requests — `api_key` defaults to the placeholder `YOUR_API_KEY` and is never populated with a real key by this generator.

query.description: Fixed for this request.
Collection variable — set api_key, never hardcode a real key here.
sms_activate-style service code.
Numeric country code (sms_activate_code).
Require a variation that allows multiple SMS to the same number.
Ceiling price in USD, 4dp. <=0/non-numeric is treated as "not set" (default sellable ceiling), never as "unlimited".

Comma-separated provider ids to restrict the purchase to (our differentiator, pre-existing). Pick ids from getPricesV3/getProviders for the same pair: pricing follows those providers' price buckets, and maxPrice is validated against their cheapest bucket. multiple=1 purchases are charged a fixed price equal to the cheapest qualifying bucket of the selected providers.
Comma-separated provider ids to exclude.
Referrer user id (integer). Binds accounts younger than 30 days that have no referrer yet; an account that already has a referrer can be re-bound at most once every 30 days. Anything else is ignored.
One of SMS, CALL_FLASH, CALL_VOICE, CALL_INTERACTIVE, RENT_SMS. Unknown value silently falls back to SMS. RENT_SMS is accepted but rental is not a supported product yet — do not rely on it.
Literal 'true'/'false'. Requires maxPrice. When 'true', the charge is locked to exactly maxPrice instead of the usual hold-then-settle-at-real-price flow. [flag: api_fixed_price_enabled]

request.description:
Purchase a phone number for a service/country.

Both GET and POST are accepted by the dispatcher; parameters are read identically either way — this request uses GET.

Accepted but currently ignored (no validation rule, silently dropped, no error): operator, phoneException, minPrice.

Automatic country detection (e.g. `country=any`) is not supported: `country` must be a numeric country code — a non-numeric or unknown country returns BAD_COUNTRY.

Comma-separated lists on this method are supported for providerIds/exceptProviderIds only. Top-level `service`/`country` do not accept comma lists here — that capability is coming soon on the price-lookup methods (getPrices/getFreePrices/getPricesV2/getPricesV3) only.

getNumberTest behaves exactly like getNumber, but is the documented way to explicitly pass activationType/testParams.
